signature.cross_longitudinal_min: Gamma_AB = -2 G hbar / d^3 (kappa=1/2); = Kafri-Taylor-Milburn mutual noise
signature.spectrum: white (Markovian): flat from DC to at least the X-ray band (1e21 rad/s) if the X-ray bound is to apply; no model cutoff
signature.T_P_dependence: none (no temperature, pressure, charge, magnetic or laser dependence)

composition.plateau: independent of composition and mass at fixed volume (Gamma ~ 1/V)
composition.below_l: universal, body-independent G hbar/(6 sqrt(pi) l^3)
composition.incoherent_l_below_0p6A: ~ <m^2>/<m> / M (heavy nuclei noisier per unit mass) - excluded region (l < 4.5 A)

geometries.geometry: LISA Pathfinder TM1-TM2 (46 mm cubes, 376 mm)
torsion dumbbell, two Au spheres 2.18e-4 kg, 40 mm apart (ASSUMED geometry)
two levitated silica spheres R = 4.8 um (Monteiro-class), d = 3R
two levitated spheres R = 1 um, d = 3 um

a_conservative.note: ~13 d quiet run (Armano 2018), white band 1-20 mHz (ASSUMED band)

a_optimistic.note: ~13 d quiet run (Armano 2018), white band 1-20 mHz (ASSUMED band)

two Westphal-class torsion masses 40 mm apart

tuning.d_composition: plateau (all l in the surviving window for bodies larger than l): CQ is composition-independent at fixed V -> differential composition signal = 0 (use only as a veto). Volume differential: CQ ~ V^-1 vs gas ~ R^-4/rho^2; separation limited by the same background-model accuracy as (a).

b_modulation.DP: no external handle: translation-invariant D0 -> noise identical in vacuum; only body swaps (V) or background modulation (P,T) -> same limit as (a)
